property: The 16-bit IPv4 Identification field remains in the base header but RFC 6864 revises when uniqueness/value is meaningful, focusing it on fragmentation and reassembly rather than all datagrams.

sources.supports: original Identification field and fragmentation role
updated field semantics reflecting current high-speed practice

negative_claims: This edge does not remove the field from IPv4.
It does not make IPv4 fragmentation obsolete by specification.
open_questions: Map kernel/NAT ID-generation behavior across implementation generations.
notes: Field width and location survive while its semantic contract is narrowed.
